svg.title: HazBot physical prototype
svg.desc: Full user-supplied prototype photograph. Pi/display and camera identifications are confirmed by the user. Photograph alone does not establish autonomous mission performance. Numbered component key: 1: ball surrogate; 2: gripper; 3: servo actuation; 4: articulated linkage; 5: raspberry pi + display; 6: lidar scanner; 7: wheel drive; 8: battery cells; 9: control electronics; 10: camera module.
